title: The Past Tense of Think
text:
Teacher: What's the past tense of "think"?
Student: Thunk.
Teacher: Don't think too hard about it.
Student: Too late. I already thunk.

title: Asking Isn't Taking
text:
Teacher: If you have 10 chocolates and your friend asks for 3, how many do you have left?
Student: Ten.
Teacher: Ten?
Student: He asked. Asking isn't taking.

title: Two Days Starting with T
text:
Teacher: Name two days of the week that start with T.
Student: Today and Tomorrow.

title: Same Dog Essay
text:
Teacher: Your essay on "My Dog" is exactly the same as your brother's.
Student: Same dog, ma'am.

title: Formula for Water
text:
Teacher: What is the chemical formula for water?
Student: H, I, J, K, L, M, N, O.
Teacher: What is that?
Student: You said it's H to O.

title: Minimalist Answer Sheet
text:
Teacher: Why is your answer sheet blank?
Student: It's a minimalist answer, sir. Less is more.
Teacher: Then your marks will be minimalist too.

title: Angry Mountain
text:
Teacher: Who can tell me what a volcano is?
Student: A mountain that got so angry it blew its top.
Teacher: Close enough. Also a description of me while checking your notebooks.

title: Homework Hijack
text:
Teacher: Where is your homework?
Student: I folded it into a paper plane and a sparrow hijacked it.
Teacher: That's the most creative thing you've written all year.

title: Low Battery Patient
text:
Patient: Doctor, I keep thinking I'm a mobile phone.
Doctor: Please sit down and let me check.
Patient: Can I sit near the plug point? I'm on 2%.

title: Spoon in the Tea
text:
Patient: Doctor, every time I drink tea I get a sharp pain in my eye.
Doctor: Try taking the spoon out first.

title: Daily Exercise
text:
Doctor: You need to exercise every day.
Patient: I already do. I jump to conclusions, run late and push my luck.

title: Eat the Plate
text:
Doctor: Your reports are in. Cut down on salt, sugar and oil.
Patient: So what do I eat? The plate?

title: Slow Tooth Extraction
text:
Patient: How much to pull this tooth?
Dentist: Two thousand rupees.
Patient: For two minutes of work?
Dentist: I can do it slowly if you prefer.

title: The Invisible Patient
text:
Patient: Doctor, I feel invisible.
Doctor: Next, please!

title: Alarm Meeting
text:
Boss: You're late again.
Employee: Sorry sir, my alarm had a meeting with the snooze button, and it ran long.

title: Two Computers
text:
Manager: Why do you have two computers open?
Employee: One for work and one to look busy when you walk by.
Manager: And which one is this?
Employee: ...The second one.

title: Biggest Weakness
text:
HR: What's your biggest weakness?
Candidate: Honesty.
HR: I don't think honesty is a weakness.
Candidate: I don't care what you think.

title: Day Off to Clean
text:
Employee: Sir, I need a day off. My wife wants help cleaning the house.
Boss: Sorry, we're too busy.
Employee: Thank you, sir. I knew I could count on you.

title: A Good Day
text: My boss told me to have a good day. So I went home.

title: Work From Home Evolution
text:
Work from home, day 1: shirt, tie, proper desk.
Work from home, day 30: pyjamas, bed, camera off, "Sorry, I was on mute."

title: The Meeting Chain
text: This meeting could have been an email. That email could have been a message. That message could have been a nap.

title: Important Day
text:
Wife: Do you know what day it is today?
Husband (panicking): Of course!
Wife: Then tell me.
Husband: The day I love you even more than yesterday.
Wife: It's garbage collection day. Take the bin out.

title: Strange Start
text:
Wife: You never listen to me!
Husband: That's a strange way to start a conversation.

title: Big Decisions
text:
Husband: I make all the big decisions in this house.
Friend: Really?
Husband: Yes. Like what India should do about climate change. My wife makes the small ones, like where we live and what we eat.

title: Melt in Your Mouth
text:
Wife: I've made a dinner that will melt in your mouth.
Husband: Wow! What is it?
Wife: Ice cream. I didn't feel like cooking.

title: Where You Left It
text:
Husband: Where's the TV remote?
Wife: Where you left it.
Husband: So... lost forever?

title: Two Become One
text: Marriage is when two people become one. The tricky part is deciding which one.

title: Moon and Stars
text:
Before marriage: "I'll bring you the moon and the stars."
After marriage: "Who left the light on? Do you know what electricity costs?"

title: Chill, I'm Worse
text: A true friend knows all your secrets and still says, "Relax, mine are worse."

title: Keeping Secrets
text:
Friend: Can you keep a secret?
Me: Yes.
Friend: So can I. Bye.

title: Leaving Home
text:
Friend: I'll text you when I leave home.
Translation: I haven't woken up yet.

title: Friend in Need
text: A friend in need is a friend who needs your streaming password.

title: Feeling a Connection
text: Are you a Wi-Fi signal? Because I'm feeling a connection. Please don't ask me for the password though.

title: Before 9 AM
text: I love you more than coffee. Please don't ask me to prove it before 9 AM.

title: Anywhere Except Everywhere
text:
Boyfriend: Where do you want to eat?
Girlfriend: Anywhere.
Boyfriend: Pizza?
Girlfriend: No.
Boyfriend: Chinese?
Girlfriend: No.
Boyfriend: So anywhere except everywhere?

title: Are You Listening
text:
Girlfriend: Are you even listening to me?
Boyfriend: Of course.
Girlfriend: Then what did I just say?
Boyfriend: "Are you even listening to me?"

title: Three Words
text:
Girlfriend: Describe me in three words.
Boyfriend: Beautiful, smart and... hungry again?

title: Family Group Chat
text: My family group chat is 10% family news and 90% good morning images with roses.

title: Organized Chaos
text:
Mom: Why is your room so messy?
Me: It's not messy. It's organized chaos.
Mom: Then I'll organize your phone into my cupboard.

title: Annoying Neighbours in Person
text:
Grandpa: In my day, we didn't have the internet.
Me: Then what did you do?
Grandpa: We had to annoy our neighbours in person.

title: Total Hundred
text:
Son: Dad, I scored 100 today!
Dad: Wonderful! In which subject?
Son: 40 in Maths, 30 in Science and 30 in English.

title: Ten Hours a Day
text:
Dad: When I was your age, I studied ten hours a day.
Son: Is that why you're so smart?
Dad: No, that's why I'm so tired.

title: The Bug in the Soup
text:
Son: Dad, are bugs good to eat?
Dad: Not at the dinner table, please.
After dinner:
Dad: So, what did you want to ask?
Son: Never mind. There was one in your soup, but it's gone now.

title: Processing Feelings
text:
Mom: Why are you so quiet today?
Son: The Wi-Fi is down, Mom. I'm processing my feelings.

title: Nobody Reaches Three
text:
Mom: I'll count to three. One... two...
Son: Mom, what happens at three?
Mom: I don't know. Nobody has ever reached it.

title: Almost Started
text:
Mom: Have you finished your homework?
Son: Almost.
Mom: How much is left?
Son: All of it. But I've almost started.

title: What Do You Need
text:
Sister: Can you do me a favour?
Brother: Depends. What's in it for me?
Sister: I won't tell Mom what you did yesterday.
Brother: What do you need, my dearest sister?

title: Enemies at Home
text: Siblings fight like enemies at home and defend each other like bodyguards outside.

title: Samosa Thief
text:
Brother: Who ate my last samosa?
Sister: The samosa thief.
Brother: And who is the samosa thief?
Sister: I don't reveal my sources.

title: Ladder to School
text: Why did the student bring a ladder to school? Because it was high school.

title: Imagined Too Far
text:
Principal: Why were you sleeping in class?
Student: The teacher said, "Close your eyes and imagine the answer." I imagined too far.

title: School Bag Growth
text:
School bag in Class 1: one notebook.
School bag in Class 10: enough books to train for weightlifting.

title: Four Pages for One Answer
text:
Question paper: 10 questions.
Me: I know one answer.
Also me: writes it across four pages with diagrams.

title: Exam Prayer
text: Student's prayer before the exam: "God, I've done my part by not studying. Now you do yours."

title: Refer to Page 12
text:
Examiner: Why did you write "Refer to page 12" as your answer?
Student: That's where the answer is in the textbook, sir.

title: Timetable Strategy
text:
My exam preparation:
Day 1: Make a timetable.
Day 2: Decorate the timetable.
Day 3: Exam.

title: Attendance Is a Crush
text: Attendance is like a crush. You only care about it when it's too low.

title: Balanced Diet
text: A hostel student's balanced diet: instant noodles in one hand, chai in the other.

title: No Copy-Paste
text:
Professor: Why did you submit a blank assignment?
Student: You said no copy-paste, sir. So I didn't paste anything.

title: Why the Sky Is Blue
text:
Kid: Dad, why is the sky blue?
Dad: Because it misses the sea.

title: A Wrinkle per Why
text:
Kid: Grandma, why do you have so many wrinkles?
Grandma: Each one is from a time you asked me "why".

title: Dino-snore
text: What do you call a sleeping dinosaur? A dino-snore!

title: Sad Maths Book
text: Why did the maths book look sad? It had too many problems.

title: Nacho Cheese
text: What do you call cheese that isn't yours? Nacho cheese!

title: Two-Tired Bicycle
text: Why can't a bicycle stand on its own? Because it's two-tired.

title: Knock Knock Lettuce
text:
Knock knock.
Who's there?
Lettuce.
Lettuce who?
Lettuce in, it's cold out here!

title: Knock Knock Boo
text:
Knock knock.
Who's there?
Boo.
Boo who?
Don't cry, it's only a joke!

title: Knock Knock Dosa
text:
Knock knock.
Who's there?
Dosa.
Dosa who?
Dosa-n't anybody want to let me in? I'm hungry!

title: Afraid of the Mouse
text: Why don't elephants use computers? They're scared of the mouse.

title: Cat on the Laptop
text: Why does the cat always sit on the laptop? To keep an eye on the mouse.

title: Great Listener
text: My dog is a great listener. He never interrupts. He just eats my homework when he disagrees.

title: Pouch Potato
text: What do you call a lazy kangaroo? A pouch potato.

title: Chimp-ion
text: What do you call a monkey who wins every award? A chimp-ion.

title: Salty Fish
text: Why do fish live in salt water? Because pepper makes them sneeze.

title: Commitment Issues
text: I told my plants I love them. Now they want commitment and a bigger pot.

title: Bed Arguments
text: I tried to be productive today, but my bed had better arguments.

title: Battery vs Motivation
text: My phone battery lasts longer than my motivation.

title: Seafood Diet
text: I'm on a seafood diet. I see food and I eat it.

title: Realistic Abs
text: I asked the gym trainer how to get six-pack abs. He said, "Stop eating junk." I said, "Let's be realistic."

title: Neighbour's Wi-Fi
text: My neighbour's Wi-Fi is my best friend. We've never met, but it's always there for me.

title: 2 AM Penguins
text:
Me: I'm going to bed early tonight.
Also me at 2 AM: watching a video on how penguins sleep.

title: Smile While You Can
text: Life is short. Smile while you still have teeth.

title: Good Morning Workout
text: Forwarding good morning messages at 6 AM should count as a morning workout.

title: Energy-Saving Mode
text: I'm not lazy. I'm in energy-saving mode.

title: Atoms Make Everything Up
text: Never trust atoms. They make up everything.

title: Construction Joke
text: I'd tell you a construction joke, but I'm still working on it.

title: Not on Speaking Terms
text: My alarm clock and I are no longer on speaking terms.

title: Anti-Gravity Book
text: I'm reading a book about anti-gravity. I can't put it down.

title: Parallel Lines
text: Parallel lines have so much in common. It's a shame they'll never meet.

title: No Reaction
text: I told a chemistry joke once, but there was no reaction.

title: Fruit Flies
text: Time flies like an arrow. Fruit flies like a banana.

title: Teleportation Book
text: I'm reading a book about teleportation. It's bound to take me places.

title: Days Ending in Y
text: My diet plan: eat less on days that end with "y".

title: Every Morning I Run
text: Every morning I run... late.

title: Cleaning the Cleaner
text: If you clean a vacuum cleaner, do you become the vacuum cleaner?

title: Rush Hour
text: Why is it called rush hour when nothing moves?

title: Workstation
text: If a train station is where trains stop, what is a workstation?

title: Parkway and Driveway
text: Why do we drive on a parkway and park on a driveway?

title: Waiting for the Waiter
text: If you're waiting for the waiter, doesn't that make you the waiter?

title: Saving Money
text:
Q: What's the best way to save money?
A: Leave your wallet at home and forget your UPI PIN.

title: Free Time
text:
Q: What do you do in your free time?
A: I think about what to do in my free time until it's over.

title: Keys That Can't Open Locks
text:
Q: What has keys but can't open any lock?
A: A piano.

title: Five Years From Now
text:
Q: Where do you see yourself in five years?
A: In a mirror, probably.

title: Always Tired
text:
Q: Why are you always tired?
A: Being this awesome all day takes energy.

title: Five More Minutes, Indian Style
text: In India, "I'm five minutes away" is not a distance. It's a feeling.

title: Guest Biscuits
text: Every Indian home has two biscuit packets: one for guests and one you're not allowed to touch because it's also for guests.

title: Aunty's Question
text:
Aunty: Beta, when are you getting married?
Me: Aunty, when are you getting a new question?

title: The Plastic Bag Bag
text: The most valuable thing in an Indian home: the plastic bag full of plastic bags.

title: Dad and the AC
text: Indian dad at 11 PM: "Switch off the AC. Keep the fan on. It's the same thing."

title: Seen at 2 AM
text: Seen at 2:14 AM. Reply at 11 AM: "Sorry, I was sleeping."
